f.n: Basin Head Marine Protected Area - Zone 1
f.pu: This zone extends from the main basin eastward for approximately 3 km to the eastern limit of the ecosystem. Zone 1 has the highest level of protection given that it encompasses the only habitat occupied by giant Irish moss within this ecosystem.
f.re: In addition to the general area restrictions, activities such as swimming, scuba diving, the use of motorized vessels and fishing are not permitted due to the vulnerability of the Irish moss in this zone.
